set.body: Purpose: reconcile the implemented trust slice with a full working-tree type-discipline and law-claim audit before publication. Exit criteria: every child is closed with discriminating tests; no trusted artifact can be forged through a weaker overload or public constructor; all public pure indexed access is total; algorithm interfaces match every admitted configuration; provenance composes rather than overwrites; generated validation evidence is bound to the actual oracle files and checked-in artifact; JVM and Scala.js gates remain green. This gate blocks the trust epic and publication.
set.title: Audit reconciliation: close remaining semantic trust gaps
